label: Share of live births outside marriage
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = Eurostat demo_find NMARPCT, the national official shares of live births outside marriage as collected by Eurostat (questionnaire collector), four sources: the DE_TOT geo-pinned German series door (65 points 1960-2024, "including former GDR"), the main all-countries slice, and the two geo-pinned French series (FX metropolitan 1960-2012, FR whole 1998-2024 — the seam the merge arbitrates by priority); per-observation status flags (b/e/p) transported as-reported. Witness tier = the OECD Family Database via OWID's chart door (OECD-compiled, 42 entities, 1960-2021). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: displayed beside each other, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): Eurostat = Eurostat reuse policy (attribution required, no endorsement implied); OWID/OECD Family Database witness = CC-BY-4.0 (OWID's chart-door terms).
notes:
THE TWELFTH INDICATOR, TODD'S ILLÉGITIMITÉ (todd_refs: 16 citations, 6 books). The corpus's notes read it as the family-anthropology fingerprint: the share of births outside marriage separates the exogamous-individualist systems (where it climbs freely — France, the Anglophone world) from the communitarian endogamous belt (where it stays near zero — Turkey 2010-2024 prints 2.6 -> 3.4, Japan ~2) and marks the communist systems' statist relaxation (the GDR's 25-35% decades, carried by the German seam's DE_TOT door). higher_is_better is REQUIRED by the schema but carries no normative claim: the corpus reads the share descriptively (levels and contrasts, never a direction), so false is the least-misleading default. THE SEX DIMENSION IS ABSENT BY CONSTRUCTION (a population-level share of live births); every point carries sex=None. UNIT: percent (the collector prints 41.7 for France 1998, 6.1 for FX 1960 — a 0-100 share, never a fraction).
CANONICAL TIER: four Eurostat sources, one collector, the same dataset as the TFR (v14's #1 — demo_find's codelist carries both: TOTFERRT and NMARPCT, two Todd metrics through one questionnaire). The main slice serves the questionnaire's respondents with their own honest freezes: the UK to 2017 (Brexit, the same end as the TFR's), Turkey 2010-2024, Russia 2006-2014 (the collector's window), Kosovo printing 2002-2021 but resolving to no ISO3 (the pending class, the same product decision as every XK row). THE GERMAN SEAM: DE_TOT (the all-Germany series, 65 points) outranks the main slice so the five pre-reunification FRG-only benchmarks (DE: 1960 6.3, 1970 5.5, 1980 7.6, 1985 9.4, 1990 10.5) all become provenance discards against the all-Germany prints (7.6, 7.2, 11.9, 16.2, 15.3) — the seam that keeps one definitionally-consistent German series while logging the other variant's every print. THE FX/FR SEAM: identical to the TFR's (FX metro 1960-1997 + FR whole 1998-2024, the 1998-2012 overlap arbitrated to FR with discards logged).
WITNESS TIER: the OECD Family Database through OWID's chart door — the worldwide-OECD face the collector never polled (Japan, South Korea, Chile, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Israel, Mexico...42 entities, 1960-2021). The vintage note is the honest divergence: the OECD's compilation ends at its 2021 vintage where the collector prints through 2024; on the co-covered EU entities the OECD anchors on the national series (France 2020: 62.2 both doors — the WPP-witness pattern, no modeling divergence to display), so the board's non-European comparisons ride the witness tier alone — the same tier split the TFR and the CBR carry.
